summary: Nvni Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a lawsuit by Amiens Technology Investments LLC in New York Supreme Court alleging missed note payments ($5.662M exchange note, $2.865M note) and failure to perfect security interests over Brazilian subsidiaries. Amiens also served an acceleration notice declaring $12,102,225.02 immediately due, plus 18% default interest. The company disputes allegations, is evaluating legal and strategic alternatives, and referenced broader restructuring initiatives. Watch for potential distressed debt restructuring, litigation outcomes, and liquidity pressures.
